 Teacher Cancels Exams And Assignments To Let Students Enjoy GTA 6 At Launch
 By Avinash Jaisrani 
 Expert Verified By
 Legendary Professor Wants Students To Enjoy GTA 6 Like He Enjoyed GTA 5 13 Years Ago!

 Share 
 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp ReddIt 
 See full bio 
 Avinash Jaisrani 
 At Tech4Gamers, I contribute as a Senior News Reporter, combining my skills and gaming enthusiasm to keep our audience updated on the latest developments. 
 See full bio 
 Story Highlight 
 A teacher is garnering praise on social media after giving his students free time to enjoy GTA 6 at launch.
 An email from Professor Juan Miguel shows that the teacher also postponed exams by a week for his students.
 Moreover, he shared the enthusiasm for GTA 6, noting that he was similarly excited for GTA 5’s release in 2013.
 With the wait for GTA 6 almost over, practically everyone has been absorbed by the hype for the game. It’s no secret that many plan to skip work to play the game , with the economy even expected to take a hit as a result of this global event.
 Some teachers also appear to be excited about GTA 6, with one even going as far as cancelling assignments in the wake of the upcoming launch .
 Why it matters: Most teachers would usually discourage students from playing games, especially one belonging to a franchise with a reputation as controversial as Grand Theft Auto.
 En españa, un profesor le suspendio todas las tareas y evaluaciones a los alumnos para que puedan disfrutar el GTA 6
 Tiene mas ganas de jugar el que todos los pibes jsjs pic.twitter.com/YgvACvursu 
 — ElBuni (@therealbuni) November 16, 2026 
 Spanish teacher Juan Miguel recently shared his enthusiasm for Rockstar Games’ biggest title , informing his students that he was the same age as them when GTA 5 launched and couldn’t wait to play the game.

 The teacher noted that he had kept workload heavier than usual in the weeks prior precisely to ensure that his students would have time on their hands to play GTA 6 . He also delayed exams by a week to give the students all the time they would need.
 I wanted you to have no worries, no chores, or deliveries from my assignments during GTA 6 launch week.
 GTA 6 Comes Out In Just 2 More Days 
 Interestingly, the professor also advised students to enjoy the game responsibly, warning against some inappropriate content that is typical of Grand Theft Auto titles. Anyhow, it appears the teacher himself is quite excited about the release.
 In the comments, many have also appreciated Juan Miguel, with some even calling him “the most legendary teacher of all time.”
